layouts.name: CBitmapSource_OutsetMargins
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: CImage::UpdateRectangle reads +0x98/+0xA0 as negative left/top and +0x9C/+0xA4 as added right/bottom. Independently, CBitmapSource::Create(sub-bitmap) stores the supplied source slice margins at +0x88. These destination outsets expand the image rectangle without changing the source slices; CImage::UpdateBitmap uses NineGridLayout for the native brush.
